text:
Sam (sales): Quick sync — Meridian Health POC: we need a final playbook + security Q answers by EOD Fri. Proposal: 2-week focused eval with three clear KPIs. Can we lock owners?
Maria (solutions): I can own prompts/evals. Need the final use-case list today. Proposed: patient triage summary, discharge note autogen, coded billing suggestion. Anything missing?
Ajay (ml-eng): I'll own perf/infra. Need seq length distribution and QPS targets to size dedicated pool. Also confirm latency SLOs.
Sam (sales): Customer asking p99 < 400ms for ~128 tokens, steady throughput ~50 r/s. Budget target ~ $0.06 per effective generation (equiv). Also they're pressing for answers on the security questionnaire.
Donna (security): I'll complete the SSP and the questionnaire. One question: for the POC, are logs considered PHI and retained by Redwood? Need to know retention window to answer controls.
Jordan (Meridian): Confirm: logs are PHI. We need assured deletion after POC and an attestation for dedicated environment (SOC2-ish). Can you confirm Private deploy options?
Maria (solutions): We can offer VPC-private, or an isolated Dedicated pool with customer-managed KMS. I'll outline both in the playbook. Draft here: https://redwood.app/notes/POC-playbook-draft (internal)
Ajay (ml-eng): For infra plan I'll test on Dedicated A100x2. Quick config I'll run:
```
model: medical-7b
quant: q4_0
batching:
  max_tokens: 512
  max_batch: 32
routing: dedicated-us-east
metrics: latency/p99, throughput, error-rate
```
Sam (sales): Perfect. Maria, capture the eval harness: sample prompts, golden outputs, pass/fail thresholds, and an explicit rollback plan. Customer wants a short readout doc with metrics and recommended next-step SKU.
Maria (solutions): Adding checkpoint criteria now: 1) Quality: ROUGE-L >= 0.75 on discharge note set; 2) Latency: p99 < 400ms; 3) Reliability: >= 99.9% successful responses. I'll attach prompt set and expected outputs.
Donna (security): I'll add security items: KMS with CMEK required, encrypted-at-rest, minimal retention (7 days) + deletion proof. Also flag: legal needs to review the customer-managed key flow.
Sam (sales): Noted. Eli, can you schedule the readout for the week after POC end? Customer asked for expansion pricing tiers (1k / 10k / 100k calls) and an outline of dedicated commitment discounts.
Eli (customer success): Will do. I'll include both hosted-per-call pricing and committed dedicated buckets. Also propose a short runway: pilot -> committed month -> enterprise contract.
ops-bot: POC checklist updated: https://redwood.app/notes/POC-1773004567-playbook (automated)
Jordan (Meridian): Also include explicit data deletion steps at POC close and an audit log manifest we can sign off on. I will share a sanitized sample PHI extract for eval purposes.
Donna (security): We'll include the purge script and a short audit manifest with checksums and timestamps. Also will answer the remaining 8 high-risk q's by Thu COB.
Sam (sales): :thumbsup: Can we aim to have the playbook, SSP, and eval set finalized by Thu COB so infra can kick on Mon? Any blockers?
Ajay (ml-eng): No infra blockers. I need the anonymized sample dataset and access to the customer's test VPC (if we go private). Jordan, can you share an S3 secure link or temp creds?
Jordan (Meridian): I'll share a secure S3 pre-signed link via the secure channel later today.
Maria (solutions): I'll upload the prompt pack and the golden outputs to the playbook doc once I get the samples. Final ask: react with :white_check_mark: when you've reviewed the doc so I know we're green to proceed.
Sam (sales): Thanks team — this is the sequence we'll present in the readout: playbook + infra config, KPI outcomes, gaps, and clear expansion ask (commit tiers). Let's keep updates in this thread.
Jordan (Meridian): Thanks — looking forward to the readout.
Donna (security): Filing questionnaire responses and SSP link in the playbook folder by Thu.
Eli (customer success): Calendar invite will go out for next Thu readout.
Maria (solutions): Uploaded prompts and eval harness v0.1 — please review.
Ajay (ml-eng): Starting perf runs Thursday AM. Will post results here.
Sam (sales): Excellent. Closing loop — if anything changes ping here or DM.
